records.title: Deep Learning System and Method for Automated Detection of Diabetic Retinopathy and Macular Edema in Low-Resource Retinal Fundus Images
records.description: An artificial intelligence-driven medical imaging framework optimized for edge inference and clinical triage of diabetic retinopathy from low-resolution fundus images captured via handheld ocular devices.
records.authors_or_inventors: Dr. Mohanasankar Sivaprakasam, Dr. Arun K. Rajagopal

records.title: Computer-Aided Diagnostic System for Pulmonary Nodule Segmentation and Malignancy Classification in Low-Dose CT Scans Using Attention CNNs
records.description: A 3D convolutional neural network architecture with volumetric spatial attention mechanisms for early detection of lung cancer lesions in chest CT scans.

records.title: Quantum Key Distribution Protocol and Photonic Transmitter for Satellite-to-Ground Free-Space Optical Cryptographic Channels
records.description: Entanglement-based quantum key generation system incorporating adaptive beam steering and atmospheric turbulence compensation for secure satellite communications.

records.title: Low-Power Neuromorphic Edge Computing Accelerator with On-Chip Spiking Neural Network Processing for IoT Sensory Nodes
records.description: Ultra-low power ASIC hardware architecture employing memristive crossbar arrays for asynchronous event-based neuromorphic processing on battery-operated edge devices.

records.title: Engineered Microbial Host and Metabolic Pathway for High-Yield Biosynthesis of 2,3-Butanediol from Lignocellulosic Hydrolysate
records.description: Synthetic biology and metabolic engineering of bacterial strains incorporating CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing for programmable bio-manufacturing of industrial chemicals.
records.organization: International Centre for Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology (ICGEB) New Delhi
records.authors_or_inventors: Dr. Syed Shams Yazdani, Naseem Mansoori

records.title: Synthetic Genetic Circuits for Programmable Biosensing of Heavy Metals and Pathogen Toxins in Aqueous Media
records.description: Cell-free synthetic biology expression cassette comprising modular transcriptional repressor gates for ultra-sensitive environmental contaminant diagnostics.

records.title: Miniaturized Electric Propulsion Hall Effect Thruster with Magnetic Shielding for Low Earth Orbit CubeSats and SmallSat Constellations
records.description: Sub-kilowatt plasma propulsion system for satellite orbit maintenance, orbital station-keeping, and collision avoidance in miniaturized satellite platforms.
records.authors_or_inventors: Dr. V. Narayanan, K. S. Biju

records.title: Additively Manufactured Semi-Cryogenic Rocket Engine Injector Head and Regenerative Cooling Jacket for Reusable Launch Vehicles
records.description: Monolithic nickel-superalloy coaxial swirl injector matrix fabricated using selective laser melting for throttling reusable rocket propulsion stages.
records.authors_or_inventors: Dr. S. Somanath, S. Unnikrishnan Nair

records.title: Autonomous In-Orbit Docking Mechanism and Proximity Operations Guidance System for Satellite Servicing and Space Debris Remediation
records.description: Computer vision and electromagnetic latching interface enabling non-cooperative target capture, active debris removal, and in-space assembly.
records.authors_or_inventors: Dr. Dipak Kumar Giri, Shubhankar Roy

records.title: Non-Invasive EEG-Based Brain-Computer Interface System with Real-Time Neural Decoding for Neuroprosthetic Limb Control
records.description: An adaptive spatial filter and Riemannian geometry manifold decoding framework for continuous motor imagery translation into multi-axis robotic prosthesis commands.
records.authors_or_inventors: Dr. Tapan K. Gandhi, Anubha Gupta

records.title: Implantable High-Density Neural Microelectrode Array with Wireless Neuromodulation and Bidirectional Neural Signal Acquisition
records.description: Biocompatible flexible polyimide microelectrode array with on-chip low-noise analog front-end for neural spike recording and closed-loop stimulation.
records.authors_or_inventors: Dr. Maryam Shojaei Baghini, Rahul Kulkarni

records.title: Stimuli-Responsive Self-Healing Polymer Nanocomposite with Reversible Diels-Alder Covalent Network for Structural Aerospace Coatings
records.description: Thermally and optically triggered autonomous crack-healing elastomeric coating incorporating functionalized graphene oxide for corrosion prevention in high-stress environments.

records.title: Collaborative Robotic Manipulator with Compliant Actuation and Deep Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Industrial Assembly
records.description: Direct force-controlled robotic arm incorporating variable stiffness elastic actuators and safe human-robot collaboration algorithms.
records.authors_or_inventors: Dr. Pushparaj Mani Pathak, Rohit Gupta

records.title: Silicon-Carbon Composite Anode Material with Conductive Graphene Scaffolding for Fast-Charging High-Capacity Lithium-Ion Batteries
records.description: Three-dimensional porous silicon-carbon nanostructure mitigating volumetric expansion during rapid lithium intercalation for electric vehicle battery packs.
records.authors_or_inventors: Dr. Surendra K. Martha, Chhail Bihari Soni

records.title: In-Situ Optical Emission Spectroscopy and Closed-Loop Defect Correction System for Directed Energy Deposition Metal 3D Printing
records.description: Real-time melt-pool temperature and plasma plume monitoring system with laser power adjustment for porosity-free additive manufacturing of aerospace components.
